title: Near-extremal finance at L=25781 forces a new early envelope deviation that kills 25781 at N0=10^6

notes: Phase 0 only. Both stop-gates fired: X is archived, and Delta_fin is uncorrelated with d_closure. No K=11, no 1054k, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
